description_en: Lists the control policies attached to the Root, a folder, or a member
description_zh: 调用ListControlPolicyAttachmentsForTarget查询资源夹或成员绑定的管控策略列表
kebab_example: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster list-control-policy-attachments-for-target --target-id fd-ZDNPiT0000 --biz-language zh-CN --control-policy-type RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListControlPolicyAttachmentsForTarget

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target. Valid values:

The ID of the Root.

The ID of a folder.

The ID of a member
parameters.help_zh:
目标节点。取值：

Root ID：查询Root节点绑定的管控策略。
资源夹ID：查询资源夹绑定的管控策略。
成员ID：查询成员绑定的管控策略
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The language for the descriptions of system control policies. Valid values:

zh-CN (default): Chinese.

en: English.

ja: Japanese.

This parameter applies only to system control policies
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果中管控策略描述的语言。取值：

zh-CN（默认值）：中文。
en：英文。
ja：日文。

该参数仅在系统管控策略时有效
parameters.name: language

ControlPolicyAttachment.description_en: The list of attached control policies
ControlPolicyAttachment.description_zh: 已绑定的管控策略列表

items.description_en: The information about an attached control policy
items.description_zh: 已绑定的管控策略列表

AttachDate.description_en: The time when the control policy was attached

Description.description_en: The description of the control policy

EffectScope.description_en:
The effective scope of the control policy. Valid values:

All: The control policy applies to Alibaba Cloud accounts, RAM users, and RAM roles.

RAM: The control policy applies only to RAM users and RAM roles
EffectScope.description_zh:
管控策略生效范围。取值：

All：表示该管控策略针对阿里云账号、RAM用户或RAM角色生效。
RAM：表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the control policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the control policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the control policy. Valid values:

System: system control policy.

Custom: custom control policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
管控策略类型。取值：

System：系统管控策略。
Custom：自定义管控策略
